lines.x: The New Zealand dollar slumped to its lowest level against the US dollar since 2009, while the S&P/NZX 50 index dropped 1.08% to 13,955.
The New Zealand dollar declined to a 17-year low against a trade-weighted basket of major currencies, posing mixed implications for domestic importers and exporters.
The Global Dairy Trade (GDT) Price Index remained flat following three consecutive auction gains, as whole milk powder prices rose while butter and fat prices declined.
